messages.author: ba283add04422124
messages.subject: Citing the ez package
parts:
Does anyone know how to properly cite this package? When I type
'citation(ez)' I get an error return. This package has been so
helpful to me I should like to give credit where credit is due.
Thanks,
kb

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] Citing the ez package
parts:
Hi Kevin,

Thanks for your interest in citing ez. Usually packages with published
descriptions include a CITATION file that is accessed by citation().
However, I haven't gotten around to publishing a description of ez
anywhere, so I haven't added a CITATION file to the package. For now,
if one wanted to cite the latest version, I'd just cite as:

Lawrence, MA. (2011) ez: Easy analysis and visualization of factorial
experiments. R package version 3.0-0.
http://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ez

Bibtex:

@Manual{rJava,
title = {\pkg{ez}: Easy analysis and visualization of factorial experiments},
author = {Michael A Lawrence},
year = {2011},
note = {\proglang{R}~package version~3.0-0},
url = {http://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ez},
}

Cheers,

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology
Dalhousie University
